questions.question:
The signal $x[n]=1+\cos (n)+\cos (\pi n)$ is given as input to a high pass filter with a cut-off frequency of 2. Select the correct statement from the following:
 a: Both $x[n]$ and $y[n]$ are periodic
 b: $x[n]$ is periodic but $y[n]$ is not
 c: $y[n]$ is periodic but $x[n]$ is not
 d: Neither $x[n]$ or $y[n]$ are periodic

An LTI system with impulse response $h[n]=x[n]-x[n-1]$ acts as an
 a: low pass filter
 b: high pass filter
 c: band pass filter
 d: all pass filter

An LTI system with impulse response $h[n]=x[n]+x[n-1]$ acts as an
 a: low pass filter
 b: high pass filter
 c: band pass filter
 d: all pass filter
